label: RICHARD DUBOIS
question: Is IMDb's Richard Dubois (nm0239470: New York bit parts 1983-84, a 1990 Canadian film role, a 2006 producer credit) the Akwaklame Company honoree of 1975? The records point to a Long Beach chemist, Richard H. DuBois, who published chemistry at Cal State Long Beach in 1968-71 and registered AkwaKlame in 1972.
tried: Academy Awards Database, IMDb, Wikidata, trade and business records. Nothing links the two men except IMDb's own award attachment, which also mislinked the co-honoree John C. Dolan; nothing proves they are different men either. Until settled, the site shows this credit without a link. An obituary, death record or Akwaklame company record would settle it.
